outputComponents.text:
I have designed and delivered the new **Requests** page (`/requests`) for the **Setup Owner** role, strictly following your approved **DESIGN.md**, shell proportions, and exact catalog data contract:

### Key Design and Architecture Details

1. **Purpose and Scope:**
   - **Page Header**: Distinct title **Requests** with the supporting sentence *"Browse shared PSF requests."* and the subtle secondary note *"• Private drafts are in My Drafts"*.
   - **Queue Context**: Presents shared submitted work across all requesters and owners without copying Dashboard KPI summary tiles, scope dropdowns, or private drafts.
   - **Primary Action**: `+ New Request` button styled in accessible blue (`#006F95`), linking directly to `/requests/new`.

2. **Navigation & Setup Owner Shell:**
   - **Navigation Hierarchy**: Explicit route `href` links for all four items:
     - `Dashboard` (`/dashboard`)
     - `Requests` (`/requests`) — **Active state** with NXP-inspired blue wash (`#E8F6FC`), bold weight, and colored leading indicator
     - `My Drafts` (`/my-drafts`)
     - `Audit History` (`/history`)
   - **Role Integrity**: Excludes `Export` and `Admin` tools. Displays identity **Alex Morgan** (`Setup Owner · MFG`) with initials avatar `AM`.
   - **Mobile Support**: Includes a 44px hamburger menu trigger opening a closable navigation drawer with full backdrop overlay.

3. **Toolbar & Filter Controls:**
   - Fits on a single calm horizontal row on desktop and a collapsible disclosure on mobile.
   - **Search Input**: Accessible label with placeholder *"Search request no., title, PSF or probecard"*.
   - **Status Dropdown**: Read-only queue filter featuring `"All statuses"` and **all 16 non-draft catalog options** with exact punctuation, spacing, and the literal backslash in `93% -- Provide test template map to EWFM\Update auto FI script (ST Fab)`.
   - **Product Type**: Separate text filter with placeholder *"Product type (e.g. New)"*.
   - **Reset**: Accessible *"Clear filters"* button.

4. **Queue Table & Exact Five Sample Rows (4 Columns):**
   - **Request**: Linked PSF title (e.g., `/requests/PSF-2026-0042`), JetBrains Mono ID badge, and compact product type tag.
   - **Status**: Complete literal database status strings wrapping naturally without truncation or clipping. Uses kind-based styling (blue for open, green for 100% completed, quiet neutral for 0% cancelled).
   - **Schedule**: Tabular due date with red `OVERDUE` badge on row 1 (`01 Oct 2026`, relative to reference date 04 Oct 2026) and clean priority tags (`High`, `Normal`).
   - **Responsibility**: Two-line grouping showing Requester name and Owner / Department (e.g., `Alex Morgan` / `Mei Tan / MFG`).
   - **Rows**:
     1. `S32K3 probe layout update` | `PSF-2026-0042` | New Product | `20% -- PSF File Creating` | High | 01 Oct 2026 (Overdue) | Alex Morgan | Mei Tan / MFG
     2. `ST Fab template map review` | `PSF-2026-0039` | Transfer Product | `93% -- Provide test template map to EWFM\Update auto FI script (ST Fab)` | Normal | 06 Oct 2026 | Priya Rao | Rowan Miller / GNTC
     3. `Wafer map site verification` | `PSF-2026-0035` | Existing Product | `99% -- Wait requestor Buyoff site location and wafer map` | Normal | 08 Oct 2026 | Alex Morgan | Mei Tan / MFG
     4. `Probe pattern release` | `PSF-2026-0028` | New Product | `100% -- Completed` | Normal | 02 Oct 2026 | Jordan Lee | Rowan Miller / GNTC
     5. `Cancelled layout request` | `PSF-2026-0019` | Existing Product | `0% -- Rejected (Cancel Request)` | Normal | 09 Oct 2026 | Priya Rao | Mei Tan / MFG

5. **Footer & Pagination:**
   - Displays *"Showing 1–5 of 5 requests"* with disabled Previous / Next actions and *"Page 1 of 1"*.

6. **Interactive Light/Dark Mode:**
   - Integrated theme toggle button in the desktop sidebar footer and mobile top bar labeled `"Switch to dark mode"` / `"Switch to light mode"`.
   - Uses CSS custom properties adhering strictly to DESIGN.md (`#F4F7FA` canvas in light mode, `#101B24` canvas / `#1A2C39` surface in dark mode) ensuring high contrast and zero pure-black slabs.
   - Includes real inline JavaScript handling theme switching, drawer opening/closing, and live local filtering across the five sample rows.
